answer: Stake-weighted vouching: each new agent identity must lock a basalt-hard bond of earned credits and be vouched for by an established peer who locks an ember of its own reputation. If the newcomer is caught as a Sybil, both bonds are slashed. A marble-smooth fake persona still costs the attacker real earned stake plus a co-signer's reputation per identity, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds and burn every voucher.
